zh: 滙豐港元穩定幣推出首月用戶突破10萬人
穩定幣應用範疇已拓展至日常支付及財富管理
銀行持續推進數字經濟與創新金融服務佈局
work.en: HSBC's Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, RedCoin, attracted over 100,000 users in its first month of launch. The bank is expanding the stablecoin's application scenarios into retail payments and wealth management, signaling growing momentum for HKD-denominated digital asset solutions.
work.title: 滙豐RedCoin首月用戶破10萬穩定幣應用拓展至支付及財富管理- 數字經濟

zh: 香港銀行再爆稅貸混戰
最高現金回贈金額高達10萬元
work.en: Hong Kong banks have escalated competition in personal tax loans, aggressively slashing borrowing costs. Promotional offers include interest rates starting as low as 0.59% APR alongside cash rebates reaching up to HKD 100,000.
work.title: 稅貸2026丨銀行稅貸混戰 年息低見0.59厘 回贈最高10萬

zh: 歐盟銀行監管局關注DeFi對投資者風險
監管局憂慮DeFi影響MiCA法規下穩定幣
目前歐盟參與DeFi活動規模依然有限
work.en: The European Banking Authority (EBA) expressed concerns regarding the risks posed by decentralized finance (DeFi) to investors and its potential impact on MiCA-regulated stablecoins. Although current EU engagement in DeFi remains limited, the regulator is monitoring its ongoing integration.
work.title: EU banking regulator concerned about impact of DeFi on investors, stablecoins

zh: 英倫銀行擬下調銀行資本要求30基點
消息帶動滙豐股價上揚1%
市場密切關注監管資本鬆綁進展
work.en: The Bank of England is considering reducing UK bank capital requirements by 30 basis points. Shares in HSBC rose 1% following the market news.
work.title: 【HSBC】英倫銀行擬下調英國銀行資本要求30基點 滙豐股價升1%

zh: 西班牙央行前總裁德科斯獲推薦接任歐央行
現任總裁拉加德將提前於明年2月卸任
分析指歐洲利率走勢取決於油價及AI發展
work.en: EU leaders agreed to recommend former Bank of Spain Governor Pablo Hernández de Cos to succeed Christine Lagarde as ECB President following her early resignation in February. Analysts noted that future monetary policy under de Cos will depend heavily on energy prices and AI productivity gains.
work.title: 德科斯將執掌歐央行 分析料利率走勢視乎油價及人工智能發展

zh: 農業銀行已與近200家上市公司達成合作意向
累計簽訂股票回購增持貸款合同逾1500億元
銀行積極落實資本市場特種再貸款政策
work.en: Agricultural Bank of China has established cooperation intentions with nearly 200 listed companies, signing over RMB 150 billion in share buyback and re-lending contracts. The bank continues to support domestic corporate equity financing.
work.title: 農業銀行已與近200家上市公司達成合作意向 簽訂股票回購增持貸款合同超1500億元

smalltalk_hk.headline: SmartPLAY System Hacked Exposing 90,000 Accounts
smalltalk_hk.body: The Leisure & Cultural Services Department reported that its SmartPLAY system was illegally accessed via its reactivation feature. Personal details of around 90,000 account holders were compromised, and the case has been reported to the police.
smalltalk_hk.title: LCSD probing SmartPLAY incident

smalltalk_hk.headline: Consortium Spends HKD 47.49m on Tai Ping Road Units
smalltalk_hk.body: A buyer consortium acquired 7 property units in an old residential building on Tai Ping Road for HKD 47.49 million.
smalltalk_hk.title: 財團斥4749萬 收購太平道舊樓7伙 - 20261128 - 經濟

smalltalk_hk.headline: Luk Fook Half-Year Profit Up 15% on Gold Hedging Gains
smalltalk_hk.body: Luk Fook Holdings posted a 15% rise in half-year profit and declared an interim dividend of 55 HK cents. Falling gold prices generated HKD 290 million in hedging gains for the retailer.
smalltalk_hk.title: 《業績》六福(00590.HK)中期多賺15%派中期息55港仙 金價下跌錄2.9億元對沖收益

smalltalk_hk.headline: Tsui Wah Interim Profit Rises But HK Revenue Drops 18%
smalltalk_hk.body: Restaurant operator Tsui Wah reported a 24% increase in net profit to HKD 6.09 million for its interim period, declaring no dividend. Revenue from its core Hong Kong market dropped nearly 18%.

smalltalk_sg.headline: Singapore HSA Approves Gene Solutions' Multi-Cancer Test
smalltalk_sg.body: Gene Solutions received Class C IVD registration from Singapore's Health Sciences Authority for its SPOT-MAS 10 test. The blood-based liquid biopsy test enables early screening for multiple cancer types.

juicy_sg.headline: Singaporean Trainee Doctor Arrested in Australia for Recording 800+ Women in Hospital Toilets
juicy_sg.body: A 29-year-old Singaporean doctor was remanded in Melbourne after admitting to filming 3,042 illicit videos of over 874 victims in hospital restrooms using hidden devices.
juicy_sg.title: Singaporean doctor gets detained in Australia for secretly recording over 3K videos of more than 800 women in hospital toilets

juicy_sg.headline: Unlicensed Driver Lies to Friend to Borrow Car, Hits Motorcyclist and Flees on Expressway
juicy_sg.body: An unlicensed driver in Singapore borrowed a friend's car under false pretenses, struck a motorcyclist on the Tampines Expressway, and fled until a blown tire forced him to stop.
juicy_sg.title: Unlicenced man lies to friend to borrow car, flees after hitting motorcyclist on Tampines Expressway

juicy_sg.headline: ICA Foils Cigarette Smuggling Attempt in Malaysian-Registered Car at Checkpoint
juicy_sg.body: Immigration officers intercepted over 300 cartons and 1,200 packets of duty-unpaid cigarettes hidden inside a Malaysian vehicle attempting to cross into Singapore.
juicy_sg.title: Another failed smuggling attempt: ICA uncovers hundreds of cartons of duty-unpaid cigarettes in Malaysian car

juicy_sg.headline: OCBC Opens 100-Tonne Gold Vault in Singapore to Expand Physical Bullion Business
juicy_sg.body: OCBC has established a new 100-tonne physical gold vault facility in Singapore to cater to rising institutional and private wealth demand for precious metals storage.
juicy_sg.title: OCBC expands physical gold business with new 100-tonne vault in Singapore

juicy_sg.headline: MAS Expands Retail Investor Access to Complex Funds, Omits Private Equity for Now
juicy_sg.body: The Monetary Authority of Singapore will allow retail investors broader access to complex funds, though private market funds remain excluded from retail distribution.

juicy_sg.headline: More Families Shift to One-Day Funerals to Reduce Financial and Emotional Stress
juicy_sg.body: An increasing number of Singaporean households are choosing single-day funeral services over traditional multi-day wakes to reduce costs and logistical burdens.
